FlashX achieves 2.57$\times$ higher search throughput than the strongest prior NAND search architecture under pSLC sensing, with a further 9.7$\times$ search reduction through clustering. This delivers 1.29--3.95$\times$ end-to-end speedup and 1.12--2.34$\times$ energy efficiency improvement over SSD-based retrieval.
tldr: FlashX proposes a CBA-based NAND flash architecture to enable scalable reuse of successful experiences for embodied agents, speeding up VLA/WAM inference via warm-start denoising while improving task success and energy efficiency.
tldr_zh: FlashX提出基于CBA的NAND闪存架构，支持具身代理大规模经验复用，通过预热去噪加速VLA/WAM推理，同时提升任务成功率和能效。
summary_zh:
具身智能体正成为复杂机器人任务中一种前景广阔的新范式，其利用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界动作模型（WAMs），通过基于扩散变换器（DiT）的迭代去噪过程生成动作。然而，现有模型在面对分布外（OOD）环境时往往难以泛化。我们观察到，检索成功经验并利用其进行去噪预热启动，能够使智能体更好地适应陌生情境，同时降低计算开销。这为同时提升任务准确性和推理效率创造了新的机会，与以往以牺牲准确性换取计算性能的加速技术形成鲜明对比。然而，实现这一机会需要扩展经验库的规模，从而带来巨大的存储和检索开销，对边缘系统的容量、带宽和功耗限制构成挑战。

为此，我们提出FlashX，一种基于CMOS直接键合阵列（CBA）的NAND闪存架构，用于具身智能体中可扩展的经验复用。FlashX利用CBA的高内部带宽进行并行的pSLC键值搜索，采用交错式存内计算（CIF）引擎以维持传感吞吐量，同时保留高密度TLC潜变量存储。基于本体感知的聚类进一步降低了检索开销，并支持无需全局重新聚类的增量式经验获取。在VLA和WAM工作负载上的评估表明，在密集配置和计算高效配置下，任务成功率分别提升了12.24个百分点和7.43个百分点。在pSLC传感条件下，FlashX的检索吞吐量比此前最强的NAND检索架构高出2.57倍，并通过聚类进一步实现了9.7倍的检索量缩减。相较于基于SSD的检索方案，FlashX带来了1.29–3.95倍的端到端加速和1.12–2.34倍的能效提升。

title: Trajectory-Calibrated Merging of Embodied Policies
summary: Robot foundation models are increasingly adapted into task specialists to expand their embodied capabilities. Yet these capabilities remain fragmented across separate policies, and existing model-merging methods do not reliably preserve them during closed-loop execution: parameter-space alignment provides only an indirect proxy for behavior, while regression may fail to preserve behavior at states not covered by its calibration inputs. We present Trajectory-Calibrated Regression (TCR), an execution-aware, gradient-free framework that consolidates robot specialists into a single policy. Across two complementary timescales, TCR collects calibration inputs from expert rollouts spanning different stages of task execution and from intermediate states within iterative action generation. To account for representation shifts introduced by merging, TCR recomputes each block's input through the already merged blocks. It then uses each expert's computation within the block to form module inputs and fits merged weights to match the experts' linear outputs. A two-pass calibration procedure further refines the merged policy using separate rollout caches while retaining the frozen specialists as teachers. The resulting model preserves the original inference graph and requires neither expert routing nor additional gradient training. On LIBERO, TCR merges four $π_{0.5}$ specialists and achieves 77.83% success across 1,200 evaluation episodes, outperforming FeatCal, RegMean, and direct weight averaging by 9.50, 24.17, and 33.00 percentage points, respectively.
tldr: TCR is a gradient-free, execution-aware model-merging framework that consolidates multiple embodied robot specialists into one policy by calibrating on expert trajectories, achieving significantly higher closed-loop success rates on LIBERO than existing merging methods.
tldr_zh: TCR是一种无需梯度、执行感知的模型合并框架，通过在专家轨迹上进行校准，将多个具身机器人专家合并为单一策略，在LIBERO上的闭环成功率显著高于已有合并方法。
summary_zh: 机器人基础模型正越来越多地被适配为任务专家，以扩展其具身能力。然而，这些能力仍然分散在不同的策略中，且现有的模型合并方法在闭环执行过程中无法可靠地保留这些能力：参数空间对齐仅提供了对行为的间接代理，而回归方法可能无法在标定输入未覆盖的状态下保留行为。我们提出了轨迹标定回归（TCR），一种执行感知、无梯度的框架，用于将机器人专家整合为单一策略。在两个互补的时间尺度上，TCR 从覆盖任务执行不同阶段的专家轨迹以及迭代动作生成过程中的中间状态中收集标定输入。为考虑合并引入的表示偏移，TCR 通过已合并的模块重新计算每个模块的输入。随后，它利用每个专家在模块内部的计算结果来构建模块输入，并拟合合并后的权重以匹配专家的线性输出。一种两遍标定流程进一步利用分离的轨迹缓存对合并后的策略进行精炼，同时保留冻结的专家作为教师。最终模型保留了原始推理图，且既不需要专家路由，也不需要额外的梯度训练。在 LIBERO 上，TCR 合并了四个 $π_{0.5}$ 专家，并在 1,200 次评估回合中实现了 77.83% 的成功率，分别比 FeatCal、RegMean 和直接权重平均高出 9.50、24.17 和 33.00 个百分点。

title: CoachSI: Self-Improvement of Robot Policies with a Language Coach
summary: Generalist robot policies execute atomic skills reliably but fail when the same skills are composed into long-horizon tasks. Self-improvement from the policy's own experience does not close this gap: experience collected by the policy alone stays within its own distribution and reproduces what it can already do. We show that what the policy lacks is not a skill but the next step. We present CoachSI, a self-improvement method in which a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) coaches the policy in language: it watches the robot and names the next step in the format of the policy's atomic instructions, and never outputs an action. Successful coached rollouts are relabeled in hindsight with the original task instruction and used to fine-tune the policy. The fine-tuned policy is then deployed on its own. On states where a World Action Model and a Vision-Language-Action model have stalled, naming the next step raises subgoal completion by 4.6x over the unchanged task instruction, and the frozen VLM supplies it from the same camera images the policy sees. After fine-tuning, unassisted success on long-horizon tasks in unseen scenes rises from 47.4% to 59.3%, 9.8 points above fine-tuning on human demonstrations and 7.3 points above fine-tuning on self-collected successes at an equal data budget. With a coach that sees only camera images, it reaches 56.8%, above both baselines. The gain is obtained with the action backbone frozen: language coaching teaches the policy what should happen next, and the skills it already has do the rest.
tldr: CoachSI uses a frozen VLM as a language coach to name the next atomic skill for a robot policy during rollouts, then relabels successful coached trajectories with the original task instruction for fine-tuning, improving long-horizon task success without altering the action backbone.
tldr_zh: CoachSI 利用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）作为语言教练，在机器人执行过程中以语言形式命名下一个原子技能，并将成功的教练轨迹重新标记为原始任务指令用于微调策略，从而在不改变动作主干的情况下提升长时程任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 通用型机器人策略能够可靠地执行原子技能，但在将这些技能组合成长期任务时却会失效。仅依靠策略自身经验的自我改进无法弥补这一差距：策略单独收集的经验始终停留在其自身分布内，只会复现其已能完成的行为。我们表明，该策略所缺乏的并非技能，而是下一步行动。我们提出了CoachSI，一种自我改进方法，其中冻结的现成视觉-语言模型（VLM）以语言形式对策略进行指导：它观察机器人，并以策略原子指令的格式命名下一步行动，且从不输出动作。成功的受指导轨迹在事后用原始任务指令重新标注，并用于微调策略。微调后的策略随后独立部署。在World Action Model和Vision-Language-Action模型均已停滞的状态下，命名下一步行动使子目标完成率相比未改变的任务指令提升了4.6倍，且冻结的VLM仅从策略所见的同一摄像头图像中获取信息即可提供该指导。微调后，在未见场景中，无辅助的长期任务成功率从47.4%提升至59.3%，分别比在人类演示上微调高出9.8个百分点，比在相同数据预算下自收集成功经验上微调高出7.3个百分点。在仅依赖摄像头图像的指导者条件下，成功率可达56.8%，同样高于两个基线。该增益是在动作主干冻结的情况下获得的：语言指导教会策略接下来应该发生什么，而策略已具备的技能则完成其余部分。

title: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
summary: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation. TuringPAI-VL is a 0.65B model built on HybridViT-MLQ, which combines convolutional local aggregation with Transformer-based global modeling. Multi-scale Latent Queries integrate spatial features and observation history within the same visual Transformer, providing a compact, structured interface to the language model. Training combines general vision-language data with geometric, cross-view, and temporal supervision. TuringPAI-VL supports general multimodal understanding and improves quantitative geometric perception over Qwen2-VL-2B, while providing a shared initialization for the two downstream VLA models. For autonomous driving, TuringPAI-Drive maintains all evaluated ADE/FDE metrics within 1.2\% of a full-token HybridViT baseline using the MLQ interface and achieves comparable aggregate scores in an in-house simulation evaluation. Using XPeng Native Runtime (XNRT) on a single NVIDIA Orin-X SoC, TuringPAI-Drive generates trajectories at 12\,Hz in on-vehicle operation. For robotic manipulation, TuringPAI-Embodied achieves a 96.8\% average success rate across the four LIBERO suites. These results demonstrate a shared vision-language foundation for driving and robotic manipulation under practical on-device constraints.
tldr: TuringPAI introduces a compact vision-language foundation model for on-device Physical AI, with a shared backbone (TuringPAI-VL) powering autonomous driving (TuringPAI-Drive) and robotic manipulation (TuringPAI-Embodied), achieving efficient real-time driving on embedded hardware and high success on LIBERO manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: TuringPAI提出了一种适用于端侧具身智能的轻量级视觉语言基础模型，其共享主干（TuringPAI-VL）支持自动驾驶（TuringPAI-Drive）和机器人操作（TuringPAI-Embodied），在嵌入式硬件上实现实时驾驶，并在LIBERO操作基准上取得高成功率。
summary_zh: 物理人工智能要求模型能够理解空间关系与动态环境，并在有限的车载计算资源下将观测转化为行动。我们提出TuringPAI，一个面向设备端物理人工智能的模型系列，包括用于共享视觉-语言理解的TuringPAI-VL、用于自动驾驶的TuringPAI-Drive，以及用于机器人操作的TuringPAI-Embodied。TuringPAI-VL是一个0.65B参数的模型，基于HybridViT-MLQ构建，该架构将卷积局部聚合与基于Transformer的全局建模相结合。多尺度潜在查询在同一视觉Transformer内整合空间特征与观测历史，为语言模型提供紧凑、结构化的接口。训练过程结合了通用视觉-语言数据与几何、跨视图和时间维度的监督信号。TuringPAI-VL支持通用多模态理解，并在定量几何感知方面优于Qwen2-VL-2B，同时为两个下游视觉-语言-动作模型提供共享初始化。在自动驾驶方面，TuringPAI-Drive通过MLQ接口在所有评估的ADE/FDE指标上保持在全Token HybridViT基线的1.2\%以内，并在内部仿真评估中取得相当的总体得分。在单个NVIDIA Orin-X系统级芯片上使用小鹏原生运行时（XNRT），TuringPAI-Drive在车载运行中以12\,Hz的频率生成轨迹。在机器人操作方面，TuringPAI-Embodied在四个LIBERO任务套件上实现了96.8\%的平均成功率。这些结果证明，在实际设备端约束下，驾驶与机器人操作可以共享统一的视觉-语言基础模型。

title: WAMotor: Accelerating World Action Models via Speculative Inference under Dual Nonuniform Denoising Dynamics
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) unify world modeling and action generation for robotic control by integrating flow-matching velocities, yet suffer from high multi-step denoising latency. Recent studies have explored speculative inference to accelerate WAMs by drafting and verifying denoising steps in parallel. However, existing methods either require training task-specific draft models or overlook critical WAM denoising dynamics when reusing past velocities as drafts. We revisit the denoising dynamics of WAMs and identify a dual nonuniformity that breaks standard velocity-reuse assumptions: velocity smoothness is nonuniform as adjacent velocity residuals differ sharply at early and final steps, so reuse there yields large residuals, which nonuniform integration time steps further translate into local state errors that accumulate into the final action distribution. Accordingly, we formalize this by theoretically deriving a trajectory error tolerance bound that characterizes how velocity residuals and integration time steps affect the final action distribution. Based on this, we propose WAMotor, the first speculative inference method tailored to the dual nonuniformity in WAMs. It selects reliable anchor velocities by deferring speculation and employs time-step-aware verification that scales acceptance thresholds by integration time step size. WAMotor offers plug-and-play benefits, enabling seamless integration with prior WAMs. Extensive evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and LIBERO-Plus show that WAMotor achieves 2.86$\times$--4.28$\times$ end-to-end speedups while maintaining task success rates. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Overdue-Lin/WAMotor
tldr: WAMotor accelerates World Action Models (WAMs) for robotic control by addressing dual nonuniform denoising dynamics, using deferred anchor velocity selection and time-step-aware verification to achieve 2.86x-4.28x speedups on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and LIBERO-Plus while preserving task success rates.
tldr_zh: WAMotor通过处理世界动作模型（WAMs）中的双重非均匀去噪动力学，采用延迟锚点速度选择和时间步感知验证，在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Plus上实现了2.86倍至4.28倍的加速，同时保持任务成功率。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过整合流匹配速度，将世界建模与动作生成统一起来用于机器人控制，然而其存在多步去噪延迟较高的问题。近期研究尝试通过投机推理来加速WAMs，即并行地进行草稿生成与验证去噪步骤。然而，现有方法要么需要训练任务专用的草稿模型，要么在复用过去速度作为草稿时忽略了WAMs关键的去噪动态特性。我们重新审视了WAMs的去噪动态，并识别出一种打破标准速度复用假设的双重非均匀性：速度平滑性是非均匀的，因为相邻速度残差在早期和最终步骤中存在显著差异，因此在这些阶段进行速度复用会产生较大的残差；而非均匀的积分时间步长进一步将这些残差转化为局部状态误差，并累积到最终的动作分布中。据此，我们从理论上推导出一个轨迹误差容忍界限，用以刻画速度残差和积分时间步长对最终动作分布的影响。基于此，我们提出了WAMotor——首个针对WAMs中双重非均匀性设计的投机推理方法。它通过延迟投机来选择可靠的锚点速度，并采用时间步长感知的验证机制，根据积分时间步长缩放接受阈值。WAMotor具有即插即用的优势，可与现有WAMs无缝集成。在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Plus上的广泛评估表明，WAMotor实现了2.86倍至4.28倍的端到端加速，同时保持了任务成功率。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Overdue-Lin/WAMotor 获取。

title: Dune: A Zeroth-Order Optimizer with Time-Conditioned Historical Error Regression for VLA Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) enables Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to handle distribution shifts during deployment without source-domain retraining. However, backpropagation-based adaptation incurs heavy memory overhead on resource-constrained robots, whereas zeroth-order (ZO) methods suffer from high estimation variance under limited perturbation budgets. We observe that while ZO estimation enables low-memory adaptation with rapid initial gains, it often stalls or degrades over long-horizon updates due to noisy gradient estimates. To address these limitations, we propose Dune, a zeroth-order optimizer that stabilizes long-horizon adaptation by coupling online historical error prediction with current perturbation observations. Specifically, Dune learns a lightweight, time-conditioned error predictor from past optimization dynamics and fuses its predictions with instantaneous ZO estimates, achieving effective variance reduction without backpropagation or extra forward passes. Additionally, we theoretically characterize how estimation variance restricts convergence in high-dimensional, small-population regimes, motivating the use of historical statistics. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and real-world robots demonstrate that Dune achieves superior success rates under a low memory footprint, with ablations confirming improved closed-loop stability and post-disturbance recovery.
tldr: Dune proposes a zeroth-order optimizer for test-time adaptation of VLA models, using a time-conditioned historical error predictor to reduce gradient estimation variance and improve long-horizon stability on robots.
tldr_zh: Dune 提出了一种用于 VLA 模型测试时适应的零阶优化器，通过时间条件历史误差预测器来降低梯度估计方差，提高长期稳定性。
summary_zh: 测试时自适应（TTA）使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够在部署期间应对分布偏移，而无需源域重新训练。然而，基于反向传播的自适应在资源受限的机器人上会带来沉重的内存开销，而零阶（ZO）方法在有限扰动预算下则面临估计方差过高的问题。我们观察到，尽管零阶估计能够实现低内存自适应并快速获得初始收益，但在长时间跨度的更新过程中，由于梯度估计噪声较大，其性能往往停滞甚至退化。为解决这些局限，我们提出Dune，一种零阶优化器，通过将在线历史误差预测与当前扰动观测相结合，稳定长时间跨度的自适应过程。具体而言，Dune从过去的优化动态中学习一个轻量级、时间条件化的误差预测器，并将其预测与瞬时零阶估计融合，从而在不依赖反向传播或额外前向传播的情况下实现有效的方差缩减。此外，我们从理论上刻画了在高维、小种群场景下估计方差如何限制收敛性，从而为使用历史统计量提供了理论依据。在LIBERO和真实机器人上的大量实验表明，Dune在低内存占用下实现了更高的成功率，消融实验进一步验证了其在闭环稳定性和扰动后恢复方面的改进。

title: Learning to Move from and for Manipulation Policies: Spatializing Latent Action Representations for Goal-Pose-Free Mobile Manipulation
summary: The success of manipulation policies is closely tied to the spatial relationship between the robot and the target object, as well as the task being performed, making the ability to adjust the robot's pose critical for successful execution. When the robot starts away from the task, such adjustments require coordinating navigation with local manipulation. Jointly training these capabilities incurs substantial computational and data costs, while navigating toward a predefined goal pose limits the flexibility needed to adapt to task-specific manipulation requirements. To address these challenges, we propose Learning to Move from and for Manipulation Policies (M4M), a framework that learns manipulation-aware mobility directly from pretrained manipulation policies. By leveraging the hidden representations of the policy's action-generating network as dense supervision, together with a limited number of manipulation execution outcomes, we learn a spatially conditioned embedding that captures task-dependent manipulation success across candidate robot poses. From the robot's current stereo observations, this representation estimates manipulation success at unvisited poses without rolling out the manipulation policy at each location. It is further integrated into navigation policy training, while a learned handoff policy decides when to transition from navigation to manipulation, enabling the robot to move and manipulate in a unified, task-aware manner. Across eight articulated-object tasks in unseen RoboCasa kitchens, M4M achieves 47.0% mean task success, compared with 26.5% for the strongest baseline and 19.2% for direct manipulation execution, and refrigerator-closing experiments show consistent improvements across four frozen manipulation policies.
tldr: This paper introduces M4M, a framework that learns manipulation-aware mobility from pretrained manipulation policies by using hidden representations as supervision, enabling goal-pose-free mobile manipulation with improved task success across unseen RoboCasa kitchens.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了M4M框架，利用预训练操作策略的隐藏表示作为监督，学习操作感知的移动性，实现无目标姿态的移动操作，在未见过的RoboCasa厨房中提高了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 操作策略的成功与机器人及目标物体之间的空间关系，以及正在执行的任务密切相关，因此，调整机器人姿态的能力对于成功执行任务至关重要。当机器人从远离任务的位置启动时，此类调整需要将导航与局部操作协同配合。联合训练这些能力会带来巨大的计算和数据成本，而向预设目标姿态导航又限制了适应特定任务操作需求所需的灵活性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了“从操作策略中学习移动并为其服务”（M4M）框架，该框架直接利用预训练操作策略来学习具备操作感知能力的移动性。通过将策略动作生成网络的隐藏表示作为密集监督信号，并结合有限数量的操作执行结果，我们学习了一种空间条件嵌入，该嵌入能够捕捉候选机器人姿态下依赖任务的操作成功率。基于机器人当前的立体观测，该表示无需在每一个位置展开操作策略，即可估计未访问姿态下的操作成功率。该表示进一步被整合到导航策略训练中，同时一个学习得到的交接策略决定何时从导航过渡到操作，从而使机器人能够以统一且任务感知的方式移动和操作。在未见的RoboCasa厨房环境中的八项铰接物体任务中，M4M实现了47.0%的平均任务成功率，而最强基线为26.5%，直接操作执行为19.2%；此外，冰箱关闭实验在四个冻结操作策略上均显示出持续改进。

title: MoRE: Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Physics Robotic World Models
summary: A robotic world model should predict how objects evolve under robot actions and physical dynamics. While recent 3D world models have shown strong predictive capabilities, they still struggle with the heterogeneous dynamics arising from diverse object interactions. To address this in a unified framework, we decompose robotic interactions into distinct physical regimes and assign each to a specialized motion expert. We introduce MoRE, a 3D world model with a mixture of motion experts organized around rigid, deformable, and prehensile dynamics. This design enables a single model to capture diverse physical behaviors while preserving regime-specific priors. Trained on mixed simulation and real-world data, MoRE integrates with Model Predictive Control (MPC) to support diverse manipulation tasks. Experiments show that MoRE improves prediction accuracy across physics regimes, leading to stronger real-world MPC performance. Code, data, and project website are available at https://alwaysleepy.github.io/MoRE-WM-site/.
tldr: MoRE introduces a 3D world model with a mixture of motion experts specialized for rigid, deformable, and prehensile dynamics, improving prediction accuracy and enabling real-world MPC for diverse manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: MoRE提出了一种具有混合运动专家的3D世界模型，专门针对刚性、可变形和抓取动力学进行优化，提高了预测精度，并支持多种操作任务的模型预测控制。
summary_zh: 机器人世界模型应当能够预测物体在机器人动作及物理动力学作用下如何演变。尽管近年来三维世界模型已展现出强大的预测能力，但在应对由多样化物体交互所产生的异质性动力学方面仍存在不足。为在一个统一框架内解决该问题，我们将机器人交互分解为不同的物理域，并将每个域分配给专门的运动专家。为此，我们提出MoRE，一种三维世界模型，其运动专家混合结构围绕刚性、可变形及抓取动力学进行组织。该设计使单一模型能够捕捉多样的物理行为，同时保留各物理域特有的先验知识。结合仿真与真实世界数据训练后，MoRE可与模型预测控制（MPC）集成，以支持多样化的操作任务。实验表明，MoRE在各类物理域中均提升了预测精度，从而增强了真实世界中MPC的性能表现。代码、数据及项目网站可在 https://alwaysleepy.github.io/MoRE-WM-site/ 获取。

title: Verify2Act: Critic-Guided Latent World Models for Verifying Language-Conditioned Manipulation Plans
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can propose multi-step manipulation plans, but they have no grounded model of how a scene will change, and the pixel-level world models that could check those plans are slow and drift over long horizons. We present Verify2Act, a modular verification framework that separates semantic action proposal from latent physical verification. A VLM proposes candidate plans, a latent world model (V2A-WM) imagines each of them in the DINOv2 feature space, and a dual-head critic checks the imagined rollouts for temporal consistency and goal satisfaction before anything is executed. V2A-WM extends recent flow-matching world models with cross-attention action grounding and a causal temporal history window. We deploy the full system on a low-cost robot arm, training the world model and critic only on data generated in a digital twin. Across six language-conditioned tasks, Verify2Act reaches 83.3\% task success, compared with 61.7\% for a latent world model without our architectural changes, 53.3\% for the VLM alone, and 46.7\% for a pixel-diffusion world model. It verified every plan it executed and incurred no planning-induced failures: all of its failed episodes were caused by low-level grasp or placement slips. In simulation, Verify2Act obtains the highest five-task chain success on CALVIN among the compared baselines with 30$\times$ fewer reflective VLM calls than pixel-diffusion verification, and the highest success on cluttered nut assembly.
tldr: Verify2Act is a modular framework that uses a latent world model with flow-matching and cross-attention to verify VLM-proposed manipulation plans in DINOv2 feature space, improving robot task success on real hardware and simulation.
tldr_zh: Verify2Act 是一个模块化框架，利用带交叉注意力的潜在世界模型在 DINOv2 特征空间中验证 VLM 提出的操作计划，在真实机器人和仿真中提高了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能够提出多步操作计划，但它们缺乏对场景如何变化的具身模型，而可用于检验这些计划的像素级世界模型则速度缓慢，且在长时间跨度中容易发生漂移。我们提出了Verify2Act，一个模块化验证框架，将语义动作提议与潜在物理验证分离开来。视觉-语言模型提出候选计划，一个潜在世界模型（V2A-WM）在DINOv2特征空间中想象每个计划，一个双头评判器在任意操作执行之前检查所想象的推演结果的时间一致性和目标满足情况。V2A-WM在近期流匹配世界模型的基础上，引入了交叉注意动作锚定和因果时间历史窗口。我们将完整系统部署在一台低成本机器人手臂上，仅使用数字孪生中生成的数据训练世界模型和评判器。在六项语言条件化任务中，Verify2Act达到了83.3%的任务成功率，而未经我们架构改进的潜在世界模型为61.7%，仅使用视觉-语言模型为53.3%，像素扩散世界模型为46.7%。它验证了执行的每个计划，并且没有出现因规划引起的失败：其所有失败案例均归因于低层抓取或放置失误。在仿真中，Verify2Act在CALVIN基准上相较于对比基线获得了最高的五项任务链成功率，且反射性视觉-语言模型调用次数比像素扩散验证少30倍，并在杂乱螺母装配任务中取得了最高成功率。

title: Bridging vision-language reasoning and learned control for legged navigation in the wild
summary: Autonomous navigation in diverse real-world environments remains one of the greatest challenges in robotics. It demands both robust low-level motion control to handle diverse terrain and high-level reasoning to interpret environmental cues. We present ROAM (Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility), a system that enables legged robots to perform kilometer-scale navigation in complex alpine and urban settings. ROAM combines the world knowledge of a Vision-Language Model (VLM), pre-trained on internet-scale data, with robust locomotion and local planning policies learned in simulation via reinforcement learning (RL). The VLM provides common-sense reasoning and semantic interpretation of the scene, assessing risks, interpreting signs, and producing semantic labels with associated navigation costs. An open-vocabulary segmentation module converts these labels into a dense, real-time risk map, which conditions two pre-trained RL policies responsible for agile locomotion and local navigation, effectively coupling high-level VLM reasoning with low-level physical control. Real-world experiments showed the system's ability to autonomously navigate a wide range of complex real-world environments. The robot completes kilometer-long hikes with minimal intervention, interprets signs to avoid danger, and evaluates its environment to identify safe areas on which to step. This work represents a step toward the reliable deployment of systems in unstructured environments. However, it also underscores the challenges that remain in VLM reliability and spatial reasoning, indicating that foundational models are a crucial component but not yet a complete solution for navigation in the wild.
tldr: ROAM integrates a VLM for semantic risk assessment with RL-based locomotion policies, enabling legged robots to perform kilometer-scale autonomous navigation in unstructured alpine and urban environments.
tldr_zh: ROAM 将 VLM 的语义风险评估与强化学习运动策略相结合，使腿式机器人在非结构化山地和城市环境中实现公里级自主导航。
summary_zh: 自主导航在多样化的现实环境中仍然是机器人技术面临的最大挑战之一。它既需要稳健的低层运动控制以应对多样地形，也需要高层推理来解读环境线索。我们提出了ROAM（鲁棒开放世界自主移动）系统，使腿式机器人能够在复杂的高山和城市环境中进行千米级导航。ROAM将视觉语言模型（VLM）的世界知识——该模型在海量互联网数据上预训练——与通过强化学习（RL）在仿真中学习到的鲁棒运动和局部规划策略相结合。VLM提供场景的常识推理和语义解读，评估风险、解读标志，并生成带有相关导航代价的语义标签。一个开放词汇分割模块将这些标签转化为稠密、实时的风险地图，该风险地图作为两个预训练RL策略的条件输入，分别负责敏捷运动和局部导航，从而有效耦合了高层VLM推理与低层物理控制。真实世界实验表明，该系统能够在广泛的复杂真实环境中自主导航。机器人以最小干预完成千米级徒步，解读标志以避免危险，并评估环境以识别安全的落脚区域。这项工作向在非结构化环境中可靠部署系统的目标迈出了一步。然而，它也凸显了VLM在可靠性和空间推理方面仍然存在的挑战，表明基础模型是关键组成部分，但尚不是野外导航的完整解决方案。

title: VG-Steer: Visual-Geometric Policy Steering from In-Context Aligned Abstractions
summary: Adapting robot policies to out-of-distribution (OOD) settings with limited real-world data remains a key bottleneck to generalist robots. The multimodality and scarcity of robotics data lead end-to-end approaches to overfit and break under small distribution shifts. Test-time adaptation can alleviate this by correcting frozen policies at inference, but most methods ground their correction in a signal learned implicitly from robotic datasets, making it susceptible to the same shifts as the policy it corrects. Recent methods that instead exploit explicit spatial information are typically limited to coarse corrections, missing the nuanced, task-relevant motion most manipulation tasks require. We propose VG-Steer, which corrects existing policies by transferring the nuanced motion of successful in-distribution rollouts, captured along meaningful geometric axes, known here as object-relational distance pairs. VG-Steer leverages the semantic understanding of Large Vision Models (LVMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) reasoning, which combines the task-relevant entity pairs and their object-relational distance projections into a single tailored visual-geometric guidance signal. In a simulation benchmark, it efficiently corrects flow-matching policies under pose and task-goal shifts; on a real robot experiment, it widens the region of the workspace the frozen policy covers, more than doubling its success rate on cable placements one grid step outside the training positions, and steers a single-task policy toward objects it was never trained on while nearly eliminating object confusion. Project website: https://arthurfenderbucker.github.io/VG-Steer/
tldr: VG-Steer corrects frozen robot policies at test-time by transferring the nuanced motion of successful in-distribution rollouts, captured via visual-geometric abstractions defined by object-relational distance pairs, using LVMs/VLMs to create a tailored guidance signal. It improves policy robustness under pose and task-goal shifts in simulation and on a real robot, more than doubling success on cable placements and reducing object confusion.
tldr_zh: VG-Steer 在测试时通过利用大型视觉模型和视觉-语言模型推理，结合对象关系距离对，从成功的分布内轨迹中转移细微运动，生成定制的视觉-几何引导信号，从而修正冻结的机器人策略。在仿真和真实机器人上，它提升了策略对位姿和任务目标偏移的鲁棒性，在电缆放置任务上成功率翻倍并减少了对象混淆。
summary_zh: 调整机器人策略以适应分布外（OOD）场景且仅依赖有限的真实世界数据，仍是实现通用型机器人的关键瓶颈。机器人数据的多模态性与稀缺性导致端到端方法在较小分布偏移下出现过拟合并失效。测试时自适应可通过在推理阶段修正冻结策略来缓解该问题，但大多数方法将其修正信号建立在从机器人数据集中隐式学习的表征上，使其易受与所修正策略相同的分布偏移影响。近期利用显式空间信息的方法通常局限于粗略修正，难以捕捉大多数操作任务所需的细致且与任务相关的运动。我们提出VG-Steer，该方法通过转移分布内成功轨迹中的细致运动来修正现有策略，这些运动沿有意义的几何轴（此处称为对象-关系距离对）进行捕捉。VG-Steer利用大型视觉模型（LVM）和视觉-语言模型（VLM）的语义理解与推理能力，将任务相关实体对及其对象-关系距离投影整合为单一定制化的视觉-几何引导信号。在仿真基准测试中，该方法在姿态与任务目标偏移下有效修正流匹配策略；在真实机器人实验中，该方法扩展了冻结策略覆盖的工作空间区域，使线缆放置任务在训练位置外一个网格步长处的成功率提升一倍以上，并引导单任务策略朝向其从未训练过的对象，同时几乎消除了对象混淆。项目网站：https://arthurfenderbucker.github.io/VG-Steer/

title: From Self-Play RL to Constrained Control: Distilling DiffMPC Students with DAgger
summary: Self-play reinforcement learning (RL) produces strong driving policies, but these policies are hard to verify or interpret. Differentiable model predictive control (DiffMPC) can enforce explicit constraints, but it is usually trained by imitating logged data or with costly RL. To add constraints to an already trained policy, we keep a PPO teacher's backbone and replace its action head with a DiffMPC that enforces road boundary half-planes and agent ellipses. We then distill the student with DAgger in the teacher's self-play simulator. Over 9 seeds, the constrained student of a smaller teacher matches its teacher on nuPlan and beats it on CARLA and on out-of-distribution Waymo scenes. For a stronger teacher, the student has fewer failures on nuPlan and Waymo, while staying level on CARLA. Its distillation takes no more than 30% of the teacher's training time.
tldr: The paper presents a method to add constraints to RL-trained driving policies by distilling a PPO teacher into a DiffMPC student using DAgger, showing improved constraint satisfaction and comparable performance on driving benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，通过DAgger将PPO教师策略蒸馏到具有显式约束的DiffMPC学生策略中，在保持性能的同时增强驾驶策略的约束满足能力。
summary_zh:
摘要：
自我对弈强化学习（Self-play RL）可生成强大的驾驶策略，但这些策略难以验证或解释。可微分模型预测控制（DiffMPC）能够施加显式约束，但通常需通过模仿记录数据或代价高昂的强化学习进行训练。为向已训练的策略添加约束，我们保留PPO教师网络的主干结构，并将其动作头替换为能施加道路边界半平面与智能体椭圆约束的DiffMPC。随后，我们利用教师网络的自我对弈模拟器中的DAgger方法对学生网络进行蒸馏。在9个随机种子下，较小教师网络对应的受约束学生网络在nuPlan上与其教师网络表现持平，并在CARLA及分布外的Waymo场景中超越教师网络。对于更强的教师网络，学生网络在nuPlan和Waymo上故障更少，同时在CARLA上保持同等水平。其蒸馏耗时不超过教师网络训练时间的30%。

title: Old-School Planners Drive (Sometimes) Better Than Learned Ones
summary: End-to-end driving models learn to plan from data, and hand-written planners are widely treated as a thing of the past. We test whether this is justified: we implement sixteen textbook planners, each combining a path source (reference line, A*, hybrid A*, RRT*) with a trajectory method (Frenet lattice, nonlinear optimization, $s$--$t$ search, dynamic window), and evaluate them on three benchmarks: open loop on nuScenes, closed loop on nuPlan with ground-truth perception, and photorealistic closed loop on HUGSIM. On HUGSIM, they replace only the planner of the end-to-end model UniAD and read its frozen perception, without an HD map or other privileged information. On nuScenes and nuPlan, the best textbook planners are competitive (L2 error of 0.735\,m against 0.947\,m for UniAD's planner; a nuPlan score of 79.3 against 76.1 for the rule-based PDM-Closed on Test14-hard with reactive agents). On HUGSIM, nine of the sixteen score above UniAD's learned planner on the same perception,. The best, a hybrid A* path followed by nonlinear trajectory optimization, raises HUGSIM's driving score (HD-Score) from 32.0 to 41.8. The gain is largest with standing and oncoming cars; against cars that steer at the ego, there is none. In 31 of the 182 runs in which UniAD's planner hits a car, the best textbook planner completes the route on the same perception: these crashes are due to the planner, not the perception.
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates sixteen classical (non-learned) trajectory planners against the learned planner of the end-to-end driving model UniAD on multiple benchmarks, finding that several classical planners outperform the learned one on the same perception, particularly in closed-loop photorealistic simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了十六种经典（非学习）轨迹规划器与端到端驾驶模型UniAD的学习规划器在多个基准上的表现，发现在相同感知条件下，多种经典规划器在闭环逼真仿真中优于学习规划器。
summary_zh: 端到端驾驶模型学会从数据中进行规划，手写的规划器被广泛视为过去式。我们检验了这一观点是否成立：我们实现了十六种教科书式规划器，每种都结合了一条路径来源（参考线、A*、混合A*、RRT*）与一种轨迹方法（Frenet晶格、非线性优化、\( s \)--\( t \)搜索、动态窗口），并在三个基准上对其进行了评估：nuScenes上的开环测试、基于真实感知的nuPlan闭环测试，以及HUGSIM上的逼真闭环测试。在HUGSIM上，这些规划器仅替换了端到端模型UniAD的规划模块，并读取其冻结的感知输出，无需高清地图或其他特权信息。在nuScenes和nuPlan上，最佳教科书式规划器具有竞争力（L2误差为0.735米，而UniAD规划器为0.947米；在含有反应式智能体的Test14-hard场景中，nuPlan得分为79.3，而基于规则的PDM-Closed为76.1）。在HUGSIM上，十六种规划器中有九种的得分高于UniAD在相同感知条件下的学习式规划器。其中最佳方案——混合A*路径结合非线性轨迹优化——将HUGSIM的驾驶得分（HD-Score）从32.0提升至41.8。该增益在静止车辆和迎面来车场景中最为显著；而在面对自车转向的车辆时，则没有提升。在UniAD规划器撞上车辆的182次运行中，有31次最佳教科书式规划器在相同感知条件下完成了路线：这些碰撞事故源于规划器，而非感知模块。

title: MAWAM: A Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
summary: Every move in a robot team changes the world in which its teammates must act. Coordinated manipulation therefore calls for predicting the team's actions together with the physical future they jointly create. We introduce MAWAM, a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates each robot's future views and executable action chunks in a single sample. Built from a pretrained single-robot world-action backbone, MAWAM jointly denoises all robots' action and future-view tokens through cross-agent attention, while preserving a separate control interface for each robot. MAWAM achieves the highest success on all three real-robot tasks (laundry-bag collection, bath-towel folding, and umbrella handover), with 67.8% mean success, 18.9 percentage points above MA-VLA trained on the same demonstrations and cameras. In simulation, MAWAM reaches 90.3% mean success on eight tasks with teams of up to four arms. Ablations show that cross-agent attention and team-stage future-video supervision both improve coordinated control: without attention, a four-arm relay falls from 95.0% to 39.0%, and without this supervision, Place Food falls from 78.0% to 47.0%.
tldr: MAWAM is a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates future views and executable actions for teams of robots via cross-agent attention, achieving higher success rates than baselines on real and simulated coordinated manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: MAWAM是一种多智能体世界动作模型，通过跨智能体注意力联合生成多个机器人的未来视图和可执行动作，在真实和模拟的协同操作任务中取得了比基线更高的成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人团队中的每一个动作都会改变其队友必须行动的环境。因此，协调操作需要同时预测团队的行动及其共同创造的物理未来。我们引入了MAWAM，一种多智能体世界-动作模型，能够在单次采样中联合生成每个机器人的未来视图和可执行动作块。MAWAM基于预训练的单机器人世界-动作骨干构建，通过跨智能体注意力联合去噪所有机器人的动作和未来视图令牌，同时为每个机器人保留独立控制接口。MAWAM在全部三项真实机器人任务（洗衣袋收集、浴巾折叠和雨伞交接）中取得了最高成功率，平均成功率达67.8%，比使用相同演示数据和摄像头训练的MA-VLA高出18.9个百分点。在仿真环境中，MAWAM在最多四臂团队参与的八项任务中平均成功率达90.3%。消融实验表明，跨智能体注意力和团队阶段未来视频监督均能改善协调控制：移除注意力机制后，四臂接力任务成功率从95.0%降至39.0%；移除该监督后，摆放食物任务成功率从78.0%降至47.0%。

title: Render the Robot, Generate the World: One Video World Model Across Embodiments
summary: Predicting the consequences of an agent's actions requires modeling both the body's motion and the environment's response. Most video world models attempt to learn both from numerical actions, even though geometry and kinematics already specify the intended motion. We introduce Doppel, an embodiment-agnostic video world model conditioned on camera-aligned renderings of future body configurations and numerical action trajectories. By explicitly providing the intended motion, Doppel can focus on predicting object motion and interaction-driven changes in the environment. Rendered motion also provides a common visual interface across different embodiments and action spaces. To train on robot datasets without camera extrinsics, we recover camera poses and align rendered trajectories with recorded observations. We jointly train a single shared video backbone and conditioning adapter on eight datasets spanning eight robot and human embodiments, from single- and bimanual robot arms to a dexterous humanoid and human hands and bodies, using about 600 hours of video without embodiment labels. Across three robot-arm datasets, Doppel improves PSNR over action-only baselines by 1.00 dB on held-out trajectories and 1.20 dB under out-of-distribution evaluation, while predicting more consistent object motion. Training on all eight embodiments (Doppel-8) improves robot predictions over the three-robot model (Doppel-3) on four of six evaluation sets. Project page: https://doppelwm.github.io/.
tldr: Doppel introduces an embodiment-agnostic video world model conditioned on camera-aligned renders of future body configurations, improving prediction across eight robot and human embodiments without embodiment labels.
tldr_zh: Doppel 提出了一种与具体形态无关的视频世界模型，通过相机对齐的未来身体渲染来提升八个机器人和人体数据集上的预测效果。
summary_zh: 预测智能体行为后果，需同时对其身体运动与环境响应进行建模。多数视频世界模型试图从数值动作中同时习得这两者，尽管几何与运动学已能明确指定预期运动。我们提出Doppel——一种与具身形态无关的视频世界模型，其条件输入为未来身体构型的相机对齐渲染图及数值动作轨迹。通过显式提供预期运动，Doppel可专注于预测物体运动及由交互引发的环境变化。渲染运动亦为不同具身形态与动作空间提供了统一的视觉接口。为在缺乏相机外参的机器人数据集上训练，我们恢复相机位姿并将渲染轨迹与记录观测对齐。我们在涵盖八种机器人及人体具身形态的八个数据集上联合训练单一共享视频骨干网络与条件适配器，形态涵盖单臂及双臂机器人、灵巧人形机器人、人类手部及全身，共使用约600小时无具身标签的视频。在三个机器人臂数据集上，Doppel在留出轨迹上将PSNR较仅基于动作的基线提升1.00 dB，在分布外评估下提升1.20 dB，同时预测出更一致的物体运动。在全部八种具身形态上训练（Doppel-8）相较三机器人模型（Doppel-3），在六个评估集中的四个上提升了机器人预测性能。项目页面：https://doppelwm.github.io/。

title: Learning to Interact in Multi-Agent Self-Play for Controllable Autonomous Driving Scenario Generation
summary: Large-scale, multi-agent self-play trains robust driving policies effectively in simulation, but controlling these models to generate specific, safety-critical edge cases remains a key challenge. Existing goal-conditioned self-play frameworks rely primarily on static map-location goals and fail to reliably produce complex agent interactions such as aggressive tailgating or adversarial cut-offs. These agent interactions are necessary for rigorous autonomous vehicle (AV) testing. To address this, we present an extended multi-agent self-play framework that introduces agent-relative dynamic goals. By conditioning policies on this extended goal representation, our framework enables targeted, controllable scenario synthesis. We demonstrate that our approach successfully generates interactive driving behaviors that static-goal baselines cannot simulate, providing a flexible tool for long-tail scenario generation in AV testing.
tldr: This paper introduces an extended multi-agent self-play framework for autonomous driving scenario generation, using agent-relative dynamic goals to enable controllable synthesis of interactive safety-critical behaviors like aggressive tailgating and adversarial cut-offs, which static-goal baselines cannot simulate.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种扩展的多智能体自博弈框架，用于自动驾驶场景生成，通过智能体相对动态目标实现可控的交互式安全关键行为合成，如激进跟车和对抗性切入，弥补了静态目标基线的不足。
summary_zh: 大规模多智能体自博弈虽能在仿真中有效训练稳健的驾驶策略，但如何控制这些模型以生成特定的安全关键边缘场景仍是一项核心挑战。现有的目标条件化自博弈框架主要依赖静态地图位置目标，难以可靠地生成诸如激进尾随或对抗性切入等复杂智能体交互行为，而这些交互对于自动驾驶车辆（AV）的严格测试而言不可或缺。为应对这一问题，我们提出了一种扩展的多智能体自博弈框架，引入了智能体相对的动态目标。通过将策略条件化于这一扩展目标表征，该框架能够实现目标导向、可控的场景合成。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够成功生成静态目标基线无法模拟的交互式驾驶行为，为自动驾驶测试中的长尾场景生成提供了一种灵活工具。

title: NereidVLA: Learning to Understand and Navigate the Underwater World
summary: Underwater navigation requires translating visual spatial cues into motion, yet marine vision-language datasets rarely include paired robot trajectories. We present NereidVLA, a vision-language-action model that transfers marine spatial knowledge to language-conditioned 3D navigation. We first train Sea2Know on approximately two million marine examples to learn target grounding, spatial relations, and scene structure without paired robot-motion supervision. We then adapt it using expert trajectories executed under simulated underwater vehicle dynamics. Given RGB histories and a language instruction, NereidVLA predicts discrete motion tokens that decode into local 3D trajectories for closed-loop tracking. Evaluation combines an independent six-dimensional underwater navigation understanding benchmark with offline prediction and closed-loop navigation. Under matched navigation training and execution settings, marine spatial pretraining increases simulation success from 72.4% to 84.4%. Without fine-tuning on the real test environment, NereidVLA achieves 78.75% success in laboratory-pool robot trials, compared with 47.50% for InternVLA-N1. These results show that marine spatial supervision can support downstream motion learning and physical underwater navigation.
tldr: NereidVLA is a vision-language-action model for underwater navigation that transfers marine spatial knowledge from a large pretraining corpus to language-conditioned 3D navigation, improving simulation and real-world pool trial success rates.
tldr_zh: NereidVLA 是一种用于水下导航的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过大规模海洋空间预训练迁移知识，提升语言指令下的3D导航性能，在仿真和真实泳池试验中均取得更高成功率。
summary_zh: 水下导航需要将视觉空间线索转化为运动指令，然而现有的海洋视觉-语言数据集很少包含配对的机器人轨迹。我们提出了NereidVLA，一种视觉-语言-动作模型，将海洋空间知识迁移至语言条件化的三维导航任务。我们首先在约两百万个海洋样本上训练Sea2Know，使其在无需配对机器人运动监督的情况下学习目标定位、空间关系及场景结构。随后，我们利用在模拟水下运载器动力学条件下执行的专家轨迹对其进行适配。给定RGB历史图像和语言指令，NereidVLA预测离散运动令牌，这些令牌可解码为用于闭环跟踪的局部三维轨迹。评估结合了独立的六维水下导航理解基准测试以及离线预测和闭环导航。在匹配的导航训练与执行设置下，海洋空间预训练将仿真成功率从72.4%提升至84.4%。在未对真实测试环境进行微调的情况下，NereidVLA在实验室水池机器人试验中达到78.75%的成功率，而InternVLA-N1仅为47.50%。这些结果表明，海洋空间监督能够支持下游运动学习及物理水下导航任务。

title: Does the Action Matter? Probing Action-Conditioned Semantic Forecasting as a World Model for Autonomous Driving
summary: World models are increasingly used in autonomous driving to predict how a scene evolves under the ego vehicle's actions, supporting counterfactual reasoning and model-based planning. However, existing evaluations focus on prediction fidelity and planning performance, and rarely verify that the predictions depend on the conditioning action. In this paper, we study action dependence in action-conditioned semantic forecasting, which predicts future semantic segmentation from past segmentations and the ego action. We compare a forecaster with feature-wise and input-level action conditioning against an identical model without action input, and measure action dependence with test-time action interventions scored by standard segmentation metrics. The evaluation is validated in a synthetic environment with known action-dependent dynamics and applied to Cityscapes and BDD100K, both within each dataset and across the two vehicle platforms. Experiments show that the executed action improves mid-term mIoU by at most 2.5 points on Cityscapes and 0.6 points on BDD100K, whereas a wrong action reduces it by up to 23.2 and 7.0 points, below the model without action input. On real data, feature-wise conditioning depends 1.6 times more on the action than input-level conditioning at similar accuracy, whereas both depend on it equally in the synthetic environment, where the history does not determine the action. These results show that an accuracy gain indicates that a driving world model uses its action, but not how strongly its forecasts depend on it. Code is available at https://github.com/binayksingh/does-action-matter.
tldr: This paper investigates whether action-conditioned semantic forecasting models for autonomous driving actually depend on the conditioning action, proposing evaluation methods and showing that accuracy gains do not indicate the strength of action dependence.
tldr_zh: 本文研究自动驾驶中的动作条件语义预测模型是否真正依赖于条件动作，提出评估方法并表明精度提升不能反映模型对动作的依赖程度。
summary_zh: 世界模型在自动驾驶中日益被用于预测自车动作下场景的演化，以支持反事实推理和基于模型的规划。然而，现有评估主要关注预测保真度和规划性能，很少验证预测是否依赖于条件动作。本文研究动作条件化语义预测中的动作依赖性，该任务从历史分割结果和自车动作预测未来的语义分割。我们将具有特征级和输入级动作条件化的预测器与不含动作输入的相同模型进行对比，并通过测试时的动作干预结合标准分割指标来衡量动作依赖性。该评估在具有已知动作依赖动态的合成环境中验证，并应用于Cityscapes和BDD100K数据集，既在各自数据集内进行，也跨两种车辆平台进行。实验表明，执行的正确动作在Cityscapes上的中期mIoU提升最多2.5个百分点，在BDD100K上最多提升0.6个百分点，而错误动作则使其分别降低多达23.2和7.0个百分点，甚至低于不含动作输入的模型。在真实数据上，特征级条件化对动作的依赖程度是输入级条件化的1.6倍，两者精度相近；而在合成环境中，两者对动作的依赖程度相同，因为其中历史信息不能确定动作。这些结果表明，精度提升仅能说明驾驶世界模型使用了动作信息，但无法反映其预测对动作的依赖强度。代码可在https://github.com/binayksingh/does-action-matter获取。

title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
summary: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). Trained on the same navigation episodes, ZeroVLN substantially outperforms representative SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on standard VLN-CE (continuous environments) benchmarks, while inducing only minor changes to the brain's weights and largely preserving its general capabilities. To our knowledge, ZeroVLN is the first slow-fast VLN framework with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain, and the first to jointly optimize its slow and fast policies through closed-loop agentic RL in VLN-CE.
tldr: ZeroVLN introduces a slow-fast navigation framework that avoids supervised fine-tuning of the VLM brain by using a semantic tool-calling interface and closed-loop RL, achieving state-of-the-art results on VLN-CE while preserving general VLM capabilities.
tldr_zh: ZeroVLN 提出了一种慢-快导航框架，通过语义工具调用接口和闭环强化学习避免对VLM大脑的监督微调，在VLN-CE上取得领先性能，同时保持VLM的通用能力。
summary_zh: 具有代表性的视觉-语言导航（VLN）方法通常将视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为“大脑”与可学习的动作头相结合，并在导航领域数据上对VLM大脑进行微调，以预测几何目标。然而，这种适配可能显著改变基础VLM的权重，并削弱其通用视觉能力。我们提出了ZeroVLN，一种慢-快导航框架，在VLM大脑无需任何导航领域SFT（监督微调）的情况下即可实现高效导航。我们并非训练大脑预测几何目标，而是为其配备一个语义工具调用接口，以自然语言形式向动作专家传达运动决策。我们首先适配动作专家以执行这些运动请求，随后通过闭环强化学习（RL）联合优化大脑的运动决策与动作专家的连续执行能力。在相同导航轨迹上训练时，ZeroVLN在标准VLN-CE（连续环境）基准上显著优于基于SFT的层次化VLN代表性方法，同时仅对大脑权重产生微小改动，并在很大程度上保留了其通用能力。据我们所知，ZeroVLN是首个VLM大脑无需导航领域SFT的慢-快VLN框架，也是首个在VLN-CE中通过闭环智能体RL联合优化其慢策略与快策略的框架。

title: DMT-Attack: Diffusion-Prior Texture Search for Closed-Loop Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely on visual feedback throughout manipulation, making them vulnerable to persistent texture attacks. However, optimized patterns can stand out from their surroundings, making an attack easier to notice and its carrier more likely to be inspected or removed. To address this limitation, our key insight is to search the structured image distribution of a diffusion model for natural-looking textures while using closed-loop feedback to identify task-disruptive candidates. Based on this idea, we propose DMT-Attack, a gradient-free gray-box attack that generates textures for ordinary scene objects such as tablecloths. A frozen text-conditioned diffusion model defines the search space, and an eight-expert latent proposal network is initialized from evaluated teacher latents and refined using rollout feedback. We evaluate DMT-Attack against pi_0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT across four LIBERO suites. DMT-Attack achieves a macro clean-conditioned attack success rate (cASR) of 57.9%, compared with 44.7% for UPA-RFAS and 19.7% for random natural textures. It also attains higher scene similarity and a lower clean-calibrated detector flag rate (45% versus 97.5-100% for optimized patch baselines). These results demonstrate that natural-looking textures can disrupt VLA visual feedback and closed-loop decision-making, motivating defenses that jointly assess visual appearance and task behavior.
tldr: This paper proposes DMT-Attack, a gradient-free gray-box attack that uses a diffusion model to generate natural-looking textures capable of disrupting the visual feedback and closed-loop decision-making of VLA policies, achieving high attack success while maintaining scene similarity and evading detection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DMT-Attack，一种利用扩散模型生成自然纹理的无梯度灰盒攻击方法，能够干扰VLA策略的视觉反馈和闭环决策，在保持场景相似性和规避检测的同时实现高攻击成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在整个操作过程中依赖视觉反馈，因此容易受到持续性纹理攻击的影响。然而，优化后的图案可能在其周围环境中显得突兀，使攻击更容易被发现，其载体也更可能被检查或移除。为解决这一局限性，我们的关键见解在于搜索扩散模型的结构化图像分布以获取自然外观的纹理，同时利用闭环反馈来识别具有任务破坏性的候选方案。基于这一思路，我们提出了DMT-Attack，一种无梯度的灰盒攻击方法，可为桌布等普通场景物体生成纹理。冻结的文本条件扩散模型定义了搜索空间，一个八专家潜变量提议网络从已评估的教师潜变量初始化，并利用 rollout 反馈进行精炼。我们在四个LIBERO套件中针对pi_0.5和OpenVLA-OFT评估了DMT-Attack。DMT-Attack在宏观干净条件下的攻击成功率（cASR）达到57.9%，而UPA-RFAS为44.7%，随机自然纹理为19.7%。同时，该方法获得了更高的场景相似度和更低的干净校准检测器触发率（45%，而优化补丁基线为97.5%-100%）。这些结果表明，自然外观的纹理能够破坏VLA视觉反馈和闭环决策，从而推动对视觉外观和任务行为进行联合评估的防御策略的研究。

title: LoongForge-Embodied: A Unified Framework for Training Heterogeneous Embodied Models
summary: Training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World-Action Models (WAMs) is computationally expensive, while their heterogeneous architectures and fragmented training stacks make system optimizations difficult to reuse across models. To address these challenges, we present LoongForge-Embodied, a native-PyTorch framework that unifies and accelerates the training of heterogeneous embodied models. At its core, LoongForge-Embodied introduces a common abstraction layer that decouples model-specific implementations from shared training infrastructure, enabling cross-model reuse without constraining individual architectures or execution requirements. Buildingon this unified infrastructure, the framework combines reusable acceleration mechanisms with model-specific and hardware-aware optimization strategies across computation, execution, memory, data I/O, and distributed communication, including FP8-based communication optimizations for DDP and FSDP. Beyond training acceleration, LoongForge-Embodied integrates a unified data infrastructure with a pipeline for synthesizing robot data from egocentric data, and an efficient evaluation framework that supports concurrency and optimized computation in simulator. Experiments across representative VLA and WAM models demonstrate 1.47x-4.38x end-to-end training throughput improvements over their corresponding open-source baselines, as well as 4.1x-23.2x faster evaluation under the same protocols.
tldr: LoongForge-Embodied presents a unified PyTorch framework that accelerates training and evaluation of heterogeneous embodied models (VLA and World-Action Models) through a common abstraction layer, reusable acceleration mechanisms, and optimized infrastructure, achieving significant throughput gains.
tldr_zh: LoongForge-Embodied 提出了一个统一的 PyTorch 框架，通过公共抽象层和可复用加速机制，显著提升了异构具身模型（VLA 和世界动作模型）的训练与评估效率。
summary_zh: 训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界-动作模型（WAMs）的计算成本高昂，而它们异构的架构和碎片化的训练堆栈使得系统优化难以跨模型复用。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了LoongForge-Embodied，一个原生PyTorch框架，用于统一并加速异构具身模型的训练。其核心在于，LoongForge-Embodied引入了一个通用抽象层，将模型特定实现与共享训练基础设施解耦，从而在不限制个体架构或执行需求的前提下实现跨模型复用。在此统一基础设施之上，该框架将可复用加速机制与模型特定及硬件感知的优化策略相结合，涵盖计算、执行、内存、数据输入输出和分布式通信等方面，包括基于FP8的通信优化以支持DDP和FSDP。除训练加速外，LoongForge-Embodied还集成了统一的数据基础设施，配备从自我中心数据合成机器人数据的流水线，以及一个支持模拟器中并发和优化计算的高效评估框架。在代表性VLA和WAM模型上的实验表明，相较于对应的开源基线，端到端训练吞吐量提升了1.47倍至4.38倍，在相同协议下的评估速度提升4.1倍至23.2倍。

title: Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds
summary: Most world models for future prediction prioritize aestetic quality of generated videos, but offer only weak physical grounding and limited geometric consistency over time, due to the lack of explicit 4D modeling. In this paper, we introduce plan4d, a possible next milestone towards building a generative plannable 4D world model that predicts future RGB videos together with dense 4D geometry, including depth, cameras, point clouds, and scene flow from an observed scene context and text-specified actions. Since training data with paired actions and dense 4D annotations is inherently scarce, plan4d leverages the complementary priors of foundational video generators and 3D reconstructors. Specifically, we propose a model-stitching architecture that couples Depth Anything 3 with LongCat-Video and augments it with an auxiliary DPT head for scene-flow prediction. The resulting model allows us to plan and generate complex, long-horizon, and fine-grained actions in a dynamic 3D scenes, while substantially improving both visual fidelity and geometric accuracy of the generated future videos. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that plan4d achieves state-of-the-art performance in generative 4D modeling of environmental reactions. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project
tldr: Plan4D introduces a generative plannable 4D world model that predicts future RGB videos with dense 4D geometry (depth, cameras, point clouds, scene flow) from text-specified actions, by coupling a video generator with a 3D reconstructor. It improves both visual fidelity and geometric accuracy for long-horizon action planning in dynamic 3D scenes.
tldr_zh: Plan4D 提出了一种可规划的生成式 4D 世界模型，能够根据文本指定的动作预测未来的 RGB 视频以及稠密的 4D 几何（深度、相机、点云、场景流），通过结合视频生成器和 3D 重建器，在动态 3D 场景中提升了长时程动作规划的视觉保真度和几何精度。
summary_zh: 大多数用于未来预测的世界模型优先考虑生成视频的美学质量，但由于缺乏显式的4D建模，其物理基础较弱，且随时间变化的几何一致性有限。本文提出plan4d，这是迈向构建生成式可规划4D世界模型的又一重要里程碑，该模型能够从观测到的场景上下文和文本指定的动作中，预测未来的RGB视频以及密集的4D几何信息，包括深度、相机参数、点云和场景流。由于带有动作标注和密集4D注释的训练数据本质上是稀缺的，plan4d利用了基础视频生成器和3D重建器的互补先验。具体而言，我们提出了一种模型拼接架构，将Depth Anything 3与LongCat-Video耦合，并附加一个辅助的DPT头用于场景流预测。所得到的模型使我们能够在动态3D场景中规划和生成复杂、长时程且细粒度的动作，同时显著提升生成未来视频的视觉保真度和几何精度。在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，plan4d在环境反应的生成式4D建模中达到了最先进的性能。项目主页：https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project

title: Risk-Controlled Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters. However, even when retrieved demonstrations are relevant to the current task, the VLA may fail to effectively utilize the retrieved information, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose R2-VLA, a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that enables reliable test-time adaptation by satisfying a user-specified task success rate requirement with minimal expert assistance. Specifically, R2-VLA learns an uncertainty predictor that estimates the uncertainty of the VLA's predicted actions given the retrieved demonstrations, guiding when to act autonomously or request expert assistance. We further introduce a task-level risk-control procedure that calibrates the uncertainty threshold to satisfy a user-specified task-failure risk requirement. Moreover, R2-VLA continually incorporates expert corrections into its retrieval memory to improve future adaptation while preserving the prescribed task-level risk guarantee. Experiments across three VLA backbones and four LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that R2-VLA improves average task success by 9.2--11.2 percentage points, achieving the desired target with fewer expert requests. These results highlight the effectiveness of connecting the usefulness of retrieved demonstrations with task-level risk control to enable successful robotic manipulation.
tldr: R2-VLA is a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that learns an uncertainty predictor and calibrates thresholds to meet user-specified task success rates while requesting expert assistance only when needed, improving performance on LIBERO benchmarks.
tldr_zh: R2-VLA 是一个风险可控的检索增强型 VLA 框架，通过学习不确定性预测器并校准阈值，在满足用户指定任务成功率的同时减少专家干预，在 LIBERO 基准上提升了性能。
summary_zh: 检索增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过在无需更新模型参数的情况下，利用专家示范作为额外上下文，实现了高效的测试时自适应。然而，即使检索到的示范与当前任务相关，VLA也可能无法有效利用检索到的信息，最终导致任务失败。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了R2-VLA，一种风险受控的检索增强VLA框架，该框架通过在最小化专家辅助的前提下满足用户指定的任务成功率要求，实现了可靠的测试时自适应。具体而言，R2-VLA学习了一个不确定性预测器，用于估计在给定检索示范条件下VLA预测动作的不确定性，从而指导系统何时自主行动或请求专家协助。我们进一步引入了一种任务级风险控制流程，该流程对不确定性阈值进行校准，以满足用户指定的任务失败风险要求。此外，R2-VLA持续将专家修正纳入其检索记忆，以改善未来的自适应能力，同时保持既定的任务级风险保证。在三个VLA骨干网络和四个LIBERO基准套件上的实验表明，R2-VLA将平均任务成功率提升了9.2至11.2个百分点，并以更少的专家请求实现了目标要求。这些结果凸显了将检索示范的实用性与任务级风险控制相结合，以实现成功机器人操作的有效性。

title: Point Dynamics as Proxy for Robotic World Models
summary: Robotic world models predict future video frames from the current observation and a sequence of robot actions. While recent models follow the given actions closely, manipulated objects often collapse or move inconsistently with the action. We attribute this to the conditioning: an action, or a rendering of the robot, specifies where the robot goes but not how the scene responds, leaving a single video model to infer the interaction dynamics implicitly while also rendering appearance. We therefore separate dynamics prediction from visual rendering, with 3D point dynamics as the proxy between them. Specifically, we lift the first frame into 3D points, simulate how they respond to the robot's motion with a learned point dynamics model, and render the simulated points back into pixel-aligned videos that any video model can read. In controlled experiments on the DROID dataset with two video renderers of different architectures, this point dynamics proxy reduces object motion error by 8.6% and 6.2% without degrading image quality, and by 8.1% on a real bimanual robot. Moreover, the video follows the simulation: more accurate dynamics yield more accurate object motion, and editing the points steers the video. This suggests that advances in dynamics modeling can translate into more faithful robotic world models.
tldr: This paper proposes decoupling dynamics prediction from visual rendering in robotic world models by using 3D point dynamics as an intermediate proxy, improving object motion accuracy on DROID and a real bimanual robot without degrading image quality.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出在机器人世界模型中，通过3D点动力学作为中间代理，将动力学预测与视觉渲染解耦，在DROID数据集和真实双臂机器人上提高了物体运动准确性，同时不降低图像质量。
summary_zh: 机器人世界模型根据当前观测和一系列机器人动作预测未来视频帧。尽管最近的模型能够紧密遵循给定的动作，但操作对象常常发生坍缩或与动作不一致的运动。我们将此归因于条件设定：动作，或机器人的渲染，指定了机器人的运动轨迹，但未指定场景如何响应，这导致单一的视频模型在渲染外观的同时隐含地推断交互动态。因此，我们将动态预测与视觉渲染分离，以3D点动态作为两者之间的代理。具体而言，我们将首帧提升为3D点，利用学习到的点动态模型模拟这些点对机器人运动的响应，并将模拟的点渲染回像素对齐的视频中，任何视频模型均可读取。在DROID数据集上使用两种不同架构的视频渲染器进行的受控实验中，这种点动态代理在不降低图像质量的情况下分别将对象运动误差降低了8.6%和6.2%，在真实双臂机器人上降低了8.1%。此外，视频遵循模拟结果：更准确的动态产生更准确的对象运动，编辑点可引导视频走向。这表明动态建模的进展可以转化为更忠实的机器人世界模型。

title: ACE-Brain-0.7: Learning Execution-Grounded Reasoning for Embodied Agents
summary: Reliable reasoning for long-horizon embodied tasks requires predictions grounded in the observed execution state. We present ACE-Brain-0.7, a 9B vision--language model that combines spatial grounding, task understanding, and progress estimation. To train the model, we curate 3.7 million question--answer pairs, drawing execution supervision from egocentric human videos, robot episodes, and simulation. These questions span different stages of an execution and connect task-level judgments with observed progress and outcomes. We then fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this collection together with additional task, spatial-grounding, and progress-estimation data. Across six public task-reasoning benchmarks, ACE-Brain-0.7 achieves an average score of 76.5, ahead of GPT-6 Astra at 72.7 and Claude Opus 5.5 at 73.5. Our model also leads the evaluated models in spatial grounding, averaging 75.90 across seven benchmarks and reaching 91.25 Acc@0.5 on RefCOCOg. Controlled evaluations further indicate that our task-only model makes more effective use of visual history and more accurately distinguishes execution states. Together, these results show that ACE-Brain-0.7 effectively combines spatial perception with temporal understanding, delivering strong execution-grounded reasoning and comparing favorably with closed-source models.
tldr: ACE-Brain-0.7 is a 9B vision-language model trained on 3.7M execution-grounded QA pairs from egocentric videos, robot episodes, and simulation, achieving strong spatial grounding and task reasoning across multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ACE-Brain-0.7 是一个 9B 视觉语言模型，基于来自第一视角视频、机器人操作和仿真的 370 万个执行级 QA 对训练，在空间定位与任务推理基准上表现优异。
summary_zh: 长时程具身任务中的可靠推理需要对观察到的执行状态进行基于事实的预测。我们提出了ACE-Brain-0.7，一个将空间定位、任务理解与进度估计相结合的9B视觉语言模型。为训练该模型，我们构建了370万个问答对，从自我中心视角的人类视频、机器人执行序列及仿真环境中提取执行监督信号。这些问题覆盖执行过程的不同阶段，将任务级判断与观察到的进度和结果相连接。随后，我们在该数据集上，连同额外的任务、空间定位及进度估计数据，对Qwen3.5-9B进行微调。在六个公开的任务推理基准上，ACE-Brain-0.7取得了76.5的平均分，领先于GPT-6 Astra的72.7分和Claude Opus 5.5的73.5分。我们的模型在空间定位方面也领先于所有被评估模型，在七个基准上的平均分为75.90，并在RefCOCOg上达到了91.25的Acc@0.5。受控评估进一步表明，我们仅针对任务优化的模型能更有效地利用视觉历史信息，并更准确地区分执行状态。综合上述结果，ACE-Brain-0.7有效结合了空间感知与时间理解，在基于执行状态的推理上表现出色，与闭源模型相比具有竞争力。

title: JARVIS: An Agent That Designs, Builds, and Tests Circuit Boards on Its Own
summary: Power electronics is central to the energy transition, but developing new hardware still relies on human-led design, fabrication, testing, and iteration. We present JARVIS, an embodied AI agent that autonomously closes this loop for circuit boards. JARVIS maintains machine-specific capabilities and constraints, scans its workspace using a robot-mounted 3D scanner, and constructs an executable digital twin in which it rehearses robot motions, fabrication steps, and circuit behavior before consuming materials. A single text instruction initiates the physical experiment. Using unmodified desktop equipment, the agent coordinates a robot arm, a PCB printer that deposits conductive silver ink and solder paste, and a pick-and-place machine. It verifies progress using cameras and sensors, then tests the fabricated circuit with an OPAL-RT real-time simulator and an oscilloscope. Based on the measurements, JARVIS diagnoses deviations from the design and generates a revised design in KiCad for subsequent rehearsal. In a demonstration involving a 60 Hz notch filter for grid-connected converter sensing, JARVIS completed a first-run experiment in 2 h 39 min without human intervention, achieving 50.6 dB attenuation at 60 Hz. Its digital-twin rehearsal identified five issues before fabrication, including a test criterion that would have incorrectly rejected a functioning board. During execution, the agent also resolved encountered faults autonomously. These results demonstrate an integrated agent-driven workflow for physical design, fabrication, measurement, and iterative improvement of power-electronic circuitry. To our knowledge, JARVIS is the first system in power electronics in which an agent closes the physical design-build-test-learn loop for circuit boards.
tldr: JARVIS is an embodied AI agent that autonomously designs, fabricates, tests, and iteratively improves power electronic circuit boards by integrating a robot arm, PCB printer, pick-and-place machine, and real-time simulator via a digital-twin rehearsal workflow.
tldr_zh: JARVIS 是一个具身智能体，通过数字孪生预演工作流整合机械臂、PCB 打印机、贴片机和实时仿真器，自主完成电力电子电路板的设计、制造、测试和迭代改进。
summary_zh: 电力电子技术处于能源转型的核心位置，但新硬件的开发仍依赖人工主导的设计、制造、测试与迭代过程。我们提出了JARVIS，一个具身人工智能智能体，能够自主闭环完成电路板的这一流程。JARVIS具备针对特定机器的能力与约束认知，利用安装在机器人上的三维扫描仪感知工作空间，并构建一个可执行的数字孪生体，在其中预先演练机器人动作、制造步骤及电路行为，然后再消耗物理材料。仅需一条文本指令，即可启动物理实验。该智能体使用未改装的桌面设备，协调控制机械臂、一台沉积导电银浆和焊膏的PCB打印机，以及一台贴片机。它通过摄像头和传感器验证各阶段进展，并使用OPAL-RT实时仿真器和示波器对制造完成的电路进行测试。基于测量结果，JARVIS诊断出与设计的偏差，并在KiCad中生成修订后的设计，供后续演练使用。在涉及用于并网变流器传感的60 Hz陷波滤波器演示中，JARVIS在无需人工干预的情况下，于2小时39分钟内完成了首次运行实验，在60 Hz处实现了50.6 dB的衰减。其数字孪生演练在制造前识别出五个问题，其中包括一个可能错误判定功能正常电路不合格的测试标准。在执行过程中，该智能体还自主解决了遇到的故障。这些结果展示了一种集成智能体驱动的工作流程，用于电力电子电路的物理设计、制造、测量及迭代改进。据我们所知，JARVIS是电力电子领域中首个实现智能体闭环完成电路板“物理设计—制造—测试—学习”循环的系统。

title: An Open-Source ROS 2 Framework for Shared Control in Surgical Teleoperation: Integrating the Haply Inverse3 with the da Vinci Research Kit
summary: Surgical teleoperation deprives surgeons of touch, forcing visual inference of tissue forces; the commercial platforms now restoring force feedback remain closed, preventing open research on haptic shared control. This paper provides a system contribution: it presents an open-source, ROS 2-native framework that integrates the compact, three-degree-of-freedom (3-DOF) Haply Inverse3 haptic device with the da~Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). The framework includes a novel mapping strategy that combines 3-DOF translational device input with separately tracked VerseGrip orientation into 6-DOF patient-side manipulator commands. Two virtual-fixture-inspired guidance modes serve as reference implementations to evaluate the framework in a within-subjects user study on a teleoperated hot-wire benchmark task in simulation, and the architecture is further demonstrated on physical dVRK hardware. Relative to unassisted manual control, linear guidance significantly reduced both the number of wire contacts and the task completion time, whereas the progressive-stiffness guidance produced consistent but statistically non-significant trends in the same direction. Subjective ratings of workload, agency, and satisfaction showed favorable descriptive trends for the guidance modes. The results demonstrate the feasibility of haptic shared control with a compact device coupled to the dVRK and provide an openly available, reproducible platform for future research. They further suggest that simpler linear feedback may be more robust for inexperienced operators than more complex profiles.
tldr: This paper presents an open-source ROS 2 framework integrating a 3-DOF haptic device with the da Vinci Research Kit for surgical teleoperation, including a user study showing that simple linear guidance reduces errors and completion time.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个开源ROS 2框架，将3自由度触觉设备与达芬奇研究套件集成用于手术遥操作，并通过用户研究表明简单的线性引导能减少错误并缩短完成时间。
summary_zh: 手术遥操作使外科医生无法感知触觉，只能通过视觉推断组织受力情况；目前商业平台虽已恢复力反馈，但其系统封闭，阻碍了触觉共享控制的开放研究。本文贡献了一套系统方案：提出了一种开源的、基于ROS 2原生框架的集成系统，将紧凑型三自由度（3-DOF）Haply Inverse3触觉设备与达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）相结合。该框架包含一种新颖的映射策略，将3-DOF平移设备输入与单独追踪的VerseGrip姿态相结合，生成6-DOF患者侧操纵器指令。两种基于虚拟夹具的引导模式作为参考实现，在模拟环境中的遥操作热丝基准任务上开展了受试者内用户研究以评估该框架，并进一步在实体dVRK硬件上进行了架构验证。与无辅助的手动控制相比，线性引导显著减少了导线接触次数和任务完成时间，而渐进刚度引导则呈现出方向一致但统计上不显著的改善趋势。主观评估中的工作负荷、自主性和满意度评分显示引导模式具有有利的描述性趋势。研究结果表明，将紧凑型设备与dVRK耦合实现触觉共享控制具有可行性，并为未来研究提供了公开可用、可复现的平台。此外，研究还提示，对于经验不足的操作者而言，简单的线性反馈可能比更复杂的反馈模式更为稳健。

title: HumanCOIN: A 12,500-Hour Dataset for Human Intent in Egocentric Manipulation
summary: First-person manipulation datasets treat the observation-action pair as the atomic unit and compress the generation and execution of an action into a policy network's weights, rendering the intent state behind the action unobservable. Human motor control research shows that intent mediates between observation and action and leaves observable traces along the intent pathway from decision to effect: gaze reaches the target before the hand, muscle load builds before contact, and cortical activity precedes the motor command. To record this pathway at scale, we present HumanCOIN, a first-person manipulation dataset built around human intent: 12,500 hours across 38 scene classes with three tiers of proxies. At the output end, the L1 attention tier (10,000 h) infers gaze from headband camera video, exposing the operator's next object of attention and reach before the hand moves. Midway, the L2 exertion tier (2,000 h) records surface EMG from armbands, making load expectations readable before execution is complete. At the origin, the L3 cognition tier (500 h) records scalp EEG, giving early readouts of task decisions and monitoring. Each tier inherits all proxies from the tiers below. The dataset further provides multi-view RGB images, depth maps and point clouds, 6-DoF head and wrist pose, and step-level action and object annotations. The controlled L3 setting additionally measures gaze, hand pose and finger kinematics directly. Clock and calibration data are released with the dataset so that any read rate can be re-aligned. The three tiers cover three stations, from visual orienting to cortical preparation, making the process behind visual-action pairs available for modeling at dataset scale. Project page: https://flagopen.github.io/HumanCOIN.
tldr: HumanCOIN is a large-scale egocentric manipulation dataset (12,500 hours) that records human intent through three proxy tiers (gaze, EMG, EEG) alongside multi-view RGB, depth, point clouds, and poses, providing rich data for modeling the intent pathway from visual attention to cortical preparation in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: HumanCOIN是一个大规模第一人称操作数据集（12,500小时），通过三层代理（注视、肌电、脑电）以及多视角RGB、深度、点云和位姿记录人类意图，为操作任务中从视觉注意到皮层准备的意图通路建模提供了丰富数据。
summary_zh: 第一人称操作数据集将观测-动作对视为原子单元，并将动作的生成与执行压缩进策略网络的权重中，使得动作背后的意图状态不可观测。人类运动控制研究表明，意图在观测与动作之间起中介作用，并沿从决策到效应的意图通路留下可观测痕迹：注视先于手到达目标，肌肉负荷在接触前建立，皮层活动先于运动指令产生。为大规模记录这一通路，我们提出了HumanCOIN，一个围绕人类意图构建的第一人称操作数据集：涵盖38个场景类别、共计12,500小时的数据，并包含三个层次的代理信号。在输出端，L1注意层次（10,000小时）通过头戴摄像头视频推断注视点，在手部移动前即揭示操作者的下一个注意对象及伸手方向。在中段，L2用力层次（2,000小时）通过臂带记录表面肌电信号，使动作执行完成前即可读取负荷预期。在源头，L3认知层次（500小时）记录头皮脑电信号，提供任务决策与监控的早期读出。每一层次均继承其下层所有代理信号。数据集还提供多视角RGB图像、深度图和点云、6自由度头部与手腕位姿，以及步骤级动作和物体标注。受控的L3设置还直接测量注视、手部姿态和手指运动学。数据集附带时钟与标定数据，任何采样率均可重新对齐。三个层次覆盖从视觉定向到皮层准备的三个站点，使视觉-动作对背后的过程可在数据集规模上进行建模。项目页面：https://flagopen.github.io/HumanCOIN。

title: LocoMuJoCo: A Comprehensive Imitation Learning Benchmark for Whole-Body Control
summary: LocoMuJoCo is an open-source benchmark for imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL) on whole-body control. The library couples MuJoCo (CPU) with MJX and the MjWarp backend (GPU) under a single API, exposes 9 humanoid, 3 (musculo-)skeletal, and 4 quadruped embodiments, and ships a curated native motion-capture dataset for every humanoid, to which it can also retarget AMASS and LAFAN1. A modular plug-in architecture makes observations, rewards, control modes, terrains, and domain randomization fully interchangeable, while compact JAX implementations of many RL and IL algorithms provide JIT-compiled end-to-end training, and the companion loco-mujoco-real repository provides sim-to-real deployment. We describe the design, the SMPL-to-robot and robot-to-robot retargeting pipeline, and a usage example. LocoMuJoCo is released under MIT at https://github.com/robfiras/loco-mujoco.
tldr: LocoMuJoCo is an open-source benchmark and library for imitation and reinforcement learning on whole-body control, offering multiple embodiments, motion-capture datasets, retargeting pipelines, and JAX-based algorithms with sim-to-real support.
tldr_zh: LocoMuJoCo是一个用于全身控制的模仿学习和强化学习的开源基准测试，提供多种体态、动作捕捉数据集、重定向流程和基于JAX的算法，并支持sim-to-real部署。
summary_zh: LocoMuJoCo是一个面向全身控制的开源基准测试平台，用于模仿学习（IL）和强化学习（RL）。该库将MuJoCo（CPU）与MJX及MjWarp后端（GPU）统一在单一API下，提供了9种人形机器人、3种（肌肉）骨骼模型和4种四足机器人形态，并为每种人形机器人附带了一个精选的原生动作捕捉数据集，同时还能将AMASS和LAFAN1数据集重定向至对应模型。其模块化插件架构使得观测、奖励、控制模式、地形和领域随机化均可完全互换，而多种RL和IL算法的紧凑JAX实现提供了JIT编译的端到端训练，配套的loco-mujoco-real代码库则支持仿真到现实的部署。本文描述了该平台的设计、SMPL到机器人及机器人到机器人的重定向流程，并给出了使用示例。LocoMuJoCo以MIT许可证发布，代码托管于https://github.com/robfiras/loco-mujoco。

title: I See You: Initial Multi-Robot LiDAR Registration with Mutual-Observation Checks
summary: Compared to single-robot deployments, multi-robot teams can significantly improve search-and-rescue (SAR) mission success by covering large areas in parallel. To collaborate effectively, these robots must be registered in a common reference frame. Standard registration methods typically rely on external infrastructure or significant map overlap, but real deployments require infrastructure-free, stationary initial alignment for immediate operation. While global LiDAR point cloud registration addresses this, existing single-scan methods often fail silently in aliased or degenerate environments. Approaches scaling beyond two agents also remain rarely evaluated in real-world scenarios. We propose a centralized, deployment-ready framework for pre-mission multi-robot registration. Our system performs pairwise coarse-to-fine alignment and actively rejects impossible pose hypotheses via deterministic plausibility checks. We validate the framework on a real-world custom dataset of four synchronized robots in various environments with ground truth. The checks reject more than a third of the incorrect pairwise registrations while falsely rejecting less than 1% of the correct ones, and reduce the number of team registrations with a wrong robot pose by 38%. Dataset and code are publicly available.
tldr: This paper presents a centralized, deployment-ready framework for multi-robot LiDAR registration that uses mutual-observation checks to reject incorrect pairwise alignments, improving accuracy and reducing registration failures in real-world search-and-rescue scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种集中式、可部署的多机器人LiDAR配准框架，通过相互观测检验拒绝错误的成对配准，提高配准精度并减少实际搜救场景中的注册失败。
summary_zh: 相较于单机器人部署，多机器人团队能够并行覆盖大范围区域，从而显著提升搜索与救援（SAR）任务的成功率。为实现有效协作，这些机器人必须统一到公共参考坐标系中。标准配准方法通常依赖外部基础设施或显著的地图重叠，而实际部署则需要无基础设施、静止初始对齐以便立即投入运行。虽然全局激光雷达点云配准可解决此问题，但现有单扫描方法在面对混叠或退化环境时往往无声失效。针对超过两个智能体的扩展方法在实际场景中的评估也较为罕见。我们提出了一种集中式、可直接部署的框架，用于任务前的多机器人配准。该系统执行成对粗到精对齐，并通过确定性合理性检查主动拒绝不可能的位姿假设。我们在包含四台同步机器人的真实自定义数据集上验证了该框架，涵盖多种环境并具备地面真值。该检查拒绝了超过三分之一错误的成对配准，同时错误拒绝正确配准的比例不足1%，并将团队配准中出现错误机器人位姿的数量减少了38%。数据集与代码均已公开。

title: Planning to Stop: Factored Certification and Terminal Repair for Noncircular Robots
summary: Tight-space navigation requires a robot to clear obstacles and stop inside its goal despite uncertainty. We present GeoDiff, a motion-program planner coupling original-goal stopped-set inclusion, witness-guided terminal repair, and factored proof compilation. An exact feasible-translation characterization guides repair; request-local reuse reduces repeated geometric work. We establish conditions for compiler equivalence and reach-and-stop soundness. Across 11,440 floorplan-derived jobs, GeoDiff certifies 61/139 tasks at 5-cm tolerance within 15 s, versus 44/139 for the stop-set baseline. The strongest observed external certificate adapter certifies 13/139 tasks from 119/139 native routes, separating route availability from certification. On tasks derived from public BARN maps, GeoDiff certifies 202/270 at 5-cm tolerance for a Jackal-shaped body, versus 3/270 for the portal baseline. Development analyses distinguish emitter savings from solver coverage, and 1,420 route-tracking episodes characterize the execution interface. These results show how terminal reasoning and proof reuse increase finite-budget certification coverage while preserving the original physical task and goal.
tldr: GeoDiff is a motion-program planner that certifies tight-space navigation for noncircular robots by combining original-goal stopped-set inclusion, witness-guided terminal repair, and factored proof compilation, significantly improving certification coverage over baselines on floorplan and BARN map tasks.
tldr_zh: GeoDiff 是一种运动程序规划器，通过结合原始目标停止集包含、见证引导的终端修复和分解证明编译，为非圆形机器人的紧凑空间导航提供认证，在平面图和 BARN 地图任务上显著提高了认证覆盖率。
summary_zh: 狭窄空间导航要求机器人在存在不确定性的情况下清除障碍并停在目标点内。我们提出了GeoDiff，一种运动程序规划器，结合了原始目标停止集包含、见证引导的终端修复以及分解式证明编译。精确的可行平移刻画指导修复过程；请求局部复用减少了重复的几何计算。我们建立了编译器等价性以及到达并停止的可靠性的条件。在11,440个基于楼层平面图的任务中，GeoDiff在15秒内以5厘米容差认证了61/139项任务，而停止集基线为44/139。所观察到的最强外部证书适配器从119/139条原生路线中认证了13/139项任务，从而将路线可用性与认证过程相分离。在基于公开BARN地图的任务中，GeoDiff针对Jackal形状的机体在5厘米容差下认证了202/270项任务，而门户基线仅为3/270。开发分析区分了发射器节省与求解器覆盖率，并利用1,420次路线跟踪事件刻画了执行接口的特征。这些结果表明，终端推理和证明复用如何在保持原始物理任务和目标的同时，提高有限预算下的认证覆盖率。

title: A Practical Proprioceptive Data Collection Utility for the Unitree GO1
summary: The Unitree Go1 is a widely used platform for legged robotics research, yet collecting proprioceptive data from it is unnecessarily difficult: the Unitree SDK is sparsely documented, and ROS1 (Robot Operating System), the Go1's native middleware, is fully deprecated. We present an open-source graphical utility that enables researchers to reliably record proprioceptive data from the Go1, including joint states, IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) readings, foot force sensor data, and gyroscope measurements, without requiring ROS expertise. The tool provides a simple GUI (Graphical User Interface) for starting, stopping, and labeling recordings in real time. The contribution of this paper is the collection utility. We characterize the acquisition quality of 51 recordings collected with it, including the achieved sampling rate and repeated samples. As a secondary, deliberately modest check that the data is useful, we train a terrain classifier on it. The results are weak: a Temporal Convolutional Network reaches about 38% accuracy on held-out recordings across ten terrain classes (10% would be chance), and a window-level split that ignores recording boundaries inflates the same measurement to about 99%. We report this as a demonstration that the logged signals carry terrain information, not as a competitive classifier. The utility is designed to lower the barrier to collecting Go1 proprioceptive data without ROS.
tldr: This paper presents an open-source GUI utility for collecting proprioceptive data from the Unitree Go1 quadruped without ROS, and demonstrates its use by training a weak terrain classifier.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于 Unitree Go1 四足机器人的开源 GUI 工具，无需 ROS 即可采集本体感觉数据，并通过训练一个性能较弱的 terrain 分类器来展示其用途。
summary_zh: 宇树Go1是腿式机器人研究中广泛使用的平台，然而从中采集本体感觉数据的难度不必要地高：宇树SDK文档稀疏，且Go1的原生中间件ROS1（机器人操作系统）已完全弃用。我们提出了一款开源图形化工具，使研究人员能够可靠地记录Go1的本体感觉数据，包括关节状态、IMU（惯性测量单元）读数、足底力传感器数据及陀螺仪测量值，且无需具备ROS专业知识。该工具提供简洁的GUI（图形用户界面），用于实时开始、停止及标注记录。本文的贡献在于该采集工具。我们表征了使用该工具采集的51组记录的数据质量，包括所达到的采样率及重复样本。作为次要且刻意保守的验证——即数据具有可用性——我们在该数据上训练了一个地形分类器。结果表明性能较弱：时间卷积网络在十个地形类别上对未参与训练的记录达到约38%的准确率（随机水平为10%），而忽略记录边界的窗口级划分则将该指标虚高至约99%。我们报告此结果仅用于证明所记录的信号包含地形信息，而非展示具竞争力的分类器。该工具旨在降低无需ROS采集Go1本体感觉数据的门槛。

title: Controlling the Humanoid Robot H1-2 With a Simulated Biologically Plausible Network
summary: Artificial Spiking Neural Networks have gained remarkable attention in the last few years due to their proven ability in simulating biological neural cultures and producing similar activity and trends. Nevertheless, whether they can be trained for humanoid locomotion while retaining biological plausibility and robust performance at once remains an open question. We study this problem by proposing a biologically inspired spiking network, trained by different learning schemes and tested on the H1-2 Unitree Humanoid. These schemes differ in how recurrent weights are trained. Ordered from most to least biologically faithful, they are: a fixed reservoir mimicking an in-vitro neural culture, where recurrent weights are kept frozen and only a linear readout is trained, the same network but with its synapses trained by reward-modulated spike timing dependent plasticity and eligibility propagation, and finally backpropagation through time as a non biological baseline for comparison. All schemes relied on distillation of a reinforcement learning expert policy with dataset aggregation. We show that e-prop reached 100% survival rate matching backpropagation through time, whereas both the fixed reservoir and the reward-modulated STDP, though the closest to biological cultures, plateaued at a much lower performance (~43.7% and ~11% survival). We explore in further detail which trends a real culture could and could not produce until now. Finally we demonstrate brief bipedal stepping on a full size humanoid H1-2.
tldr: This paper proposes a biologically inspired spiking neural network for humanoid locomotion, trained via distillation from a reinforcement learning expert, and demonstrates that e-prop achieves 100% survival rate on a full-size H1-2 humanoid, matching backpropagation through time.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种生物启发的脉冲神经网络用于人形机器人运动，通过从强化学习专家策略中蒸馏训练，并证明 e-prop 在全尺寸 H1-2 人形机器人上达到 100% 的存活率，与时间反向传播相当。
summary_zh: 人工尖峰神经网络近年来因被证实能够模拟生物神经培养物并产生相似的活动与趋势而受到广泛关注。然而，这些网络能否在保持生物合理性和稳健性能的同时，被训练用于类人机器人运动，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们通过提出一种受生物启发的尖峰网络来研究这一问题，该网络采用不同的学习方案进行训练，并在H1-2 Unitree人形机器人上进行了测试。这些方案的不同之处在于循环权重的训练方式。按照生物保真度从高到低排列，它们分别是：一个模拟体外神经培养物的固定储备池，其中循环权重保持冻结，仅训练线性读出层；同一网络但突触通过奖励调节的尖峰时间依赖可塑性和资格传播进行训练；最后是通过时间反向传播作为非生物基线的对照方法。所有方案均依赖于强化学习专家策略的知识蒸馏与数据集聚合。我们表明，e-prop达到了100%的存活率，与时间反向传播相当，而固定储备池和奖励调节的STDP虽然最接近生物培养物，但其性能却停滞在较低水平（存活率分别约为43.7%和11%）。我们进一步详细探讨了迄今真实培养物能够和不能产生的趋势。最后，我们在全尺寸人形机器人H1-2上演示了短暂的双足行走。

title: Close&Safe: Maximal Task Preservation for Redundant Manipulators via C-Space Boundary Detour
summary: Contact-rich manipulation such as wiping, polishing and surface inspection specifies the task as a continuous end-effector trajectory rather than a goal pose. When an obstacle absent from the planning model intersects it, conventional planners return a collision-free path that may differ from the nominal throughout, discarding trajectory that was never obstructed. We present Close&Safe (Close to the intended task, Safe from obstacles), which decouples tracking from avoidance: the nominal is followed exactly wherever it remains feasible, and avoidance acts only on the interval where it is not, so tracking is hindered as little as the obstacle allows. On that interval we sample the configuration-space obstacle boundary within a corridor around the nominal, connect the samples into a roadmap, and search it for the detour that deviates least before rejoining the nominal at the earliest feasible configuration. We evaluate across diverse simulated obstacle configurations, physical Franka experiments, and ablations of key algorithmic components. The results demonstrate collision-free trajectory repair with localized task modification, while recovering 52.4-78% in simulation and on hardware.
tldr: Close&Safe proposes a planning method for redundant manipulators that preserves the nominal end-effector trajectory wherever feasible and locally detours around unexpected obstacles via C-space boundary sampling, achieving collision-free task repair with minimal deviation.
tldr_zh: Close&Safe 提出一种冗余机械臂规划方法，在可行处严格保持标称末端轨迹，并在障碍物附近通过 C 空间边界采样局部绕行，实现碰撞避免且任务偏差最小化。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作任务（如擦拭、抛光和表面检测）将任务定义为连续的末端执行器轨迹，而非目标位姿。当规划模型中未包含的障碍物与该轨迹相交时，传统规划器会返回一条整体上可能偏离标称轨迹的无碰撞路径，从而丢弃了本未受阻碍的轨迹部分。我们提出了Close&Safe方法（贴近预期任务，远离障碍物），将轨迹跟踪与避障解耦：在标称轨迹可行的位置严格沿其执行，仅在不可行的区间内启动避障，从而使跟踪受障碍物的影响降至最低。在该区间内，我们在标称轨迹周围的通道中采样构型空间中的障碍物边界，将样本连接为路标图，并搜索其中偏离最小、且能在最早可行构型处重新汇入标称轨迹的绕行路径。我们通过多种模拟障碍物配置、实体Franka机器人实验以及关键算法组件的消融研究进行了评估。结果表明，该方法实现了局部任务修改下的无碰撞轨迹修复，在仿真和硬件实验中恢复率达到52.4%-78%。

title: Fast and Accurate Body Estimation in Pixels, World Space and Scenes
